description: LEGACY wallet flow — new integrations should use create_account and launch_campaign (API key + prepaid balance, no wallet). First step of creating a campaign session. Returns the exact message you must sign with your Solana wallet, and the nonce inside it. Pass the message and your base58 signature to initialize_session. Nonces expire after 5 minutes, and a message signed for the dashboard will not work here.
name: get_session_nonce
